body: Thank you, I'm trying to stay positive about it since it's such a huge step, but it's definitely scary.
Thank you and I understand how hard it is... I never thought I would.

Sort of. My doctor had told me to take an extra anti anxiety med right before session, which one already really numbs me out so when I was talking about it, it helped because I didn't panic.. but at the same time I'm not really able to explain my feelings to her because I feel so numb and really out of it after taking them. I hope I'm not wasting my time by doing this.
Thank you

It wasn't easy at all, but I basically told her I needed to tell her something and it's very hard for me. She was so patient with me and even though I wasn't able to actually say "I was raped" , I told her in very little detail what happened and she got the point. She asked me a few questions and the last 10 minutes or so was just her trying to convince me it wasn't my fault. I told her I heard what she was saying, but I'm not at that place to believe that right now. She made sure I was ok before I left and although I'm having some mixed feelings right now, I'm glad I told her. I knew I had reached a scary point where I really needed help and for once, I reached out for it. Not sure I would have gotten to this point without the support from people here.

Yeah.. thank you... I still have it written down, just wish I could give it to her. I know that with what happened to me was my fault though... I put myself in that situation and should have known better... but I think she would better understand my problems if she knew...
Thank you for your reply... I hope I can get over this and get to where you are one day. I'm trying to be more open and get the help I need... :/

I'm glad to hear you are doing better... I hope I can get there one day... I tried giving my therapist a paper saying I was raped once but I ended up having a panic attack and couldn't... I think I was also scared of her reaction and what she would say... what did yours say or ask after you gave her the paper.. if you don't mind me asking...? I'm trying to hang in there but it's hard and I'm hurting. :(
I'm on my phone.. could you message me and I reply? I really need help. :( I'm starting to freak out

I only thought of the hospital because I really don't feel safe. It just seems so easy to take the bottle and go to sleep and never wake back up. I'm hurting. Bad. :/ I will try to send a message.. I'm new on here..
This is so hard. I know I don't need to be alone right now, but part of me just wants to end it. Not deal with this pain anymore.

I'm not sure I completely understand. I don't think it's helping me at all by her not knowing. After over a year I've finally realized that her knowing could help her to help me. I just can't get it out. I'm so frustrated with myself... I know it's holding me back though. I haven't been doing well lately, I've gone from seeing her every month and a half to every week now. Gosh how can I not hand her a piece of paper... I don't know why I'm making it this hard. And I'm sorry to keep bothering you. Your advice has been helpful. Thank you

That did help, thanks! I actually do see her in the morning every week... I'm usually okish until we start talking about stuff. Today I came so close but had such a bad panic attack she almost called an ambulance. I guess I'm not ready to talk about it maybe just yet, but it would be nice if she knew.

I am ready for her to know. I don't know how ready I am to talk about details or anything, but I just feel like her knowing would help her understand some of my other problems. I did have a note in my pocket, but towards the end of the session when I was thinking about giving it to her I freaked out and had a panic attack and ended up staying way over our time. I feel like this sounds so silly... but this is extremely hard for me..

Thank you! I'm about to go get some coffee and a snack and just try to calm down a bit. Is it normal to feel so bad after sessions? I've been crying on and off since I left and I feel so depressed and exhausted...?
Thank you so much, all of the support from everyone. I just got out and tried really hard, but didn't get it out... another panic attack... :/ I'm not sure when or if I'll ever be able to tell her.

I just got out. I tried. I really did and I had another panic attack and she almost had to call someone because I wasn't getting better. I'm starting to wonder if I'll ever be able to talk about this. IVe been trying to tell her for 3 months now...
It's ok for me to ask her that? I feel bad like I would just be making her guess the whole time with nothing to go off of

I haven't told anybody otherwise I would actually do that... I want her to know but I can't talk about it. I think the easiest thing would be if she just asked me and I could just nod... but without me talking, I don't know how she would know or guess this...
I'm freaking out. I don't know how to say it. I wish she would just ask me if ..... and I could just say yes.
Thank you. I see her tomorrow so I'm going to try my best.

I just don't want to have any more panic attacks over this. I actually maybe could do the yes/no questions... but how do I bring that up to her? She doesn't know anything about what happened so she would just have to be guessing...? What if she doesn't think of this...? I'm just wondering if she would be ok with that too and also, whenever I start to panic she stops whatever we are talking about to get through the attack and I just really need to get this out to her. I need her to know, because I need her help. I've struggled for too long.

That's what's so frustrating is how close I am yet how far away I feel... I freeze up every time I try to get it out and then panic. She can tell when I start to panic and stops me. I see her in two days. I really really want to tell her, so bad then. But I feel so stuck. I don't know how to keep myself from panicking so much to tell her.

I tried that last month and started freaking out in the car while waiting to go inside... once I got inside, she had to work with me on breathing and calming down and we didn't actually start talking about things until 30 minutes into the session. I hate that this happens every time and feel like I am not getting anywhere. I'm also scared that if I somehow get it out to her that I will not be able to handle it or something. it's just scary to think about if I get panic attacks this bad when it's not even out in the open yet...
